column1: Don't go near the edge in a wind.
column2: 起风的时候别靠近边上。

column1: There's more of them than of us.
Every boat here has a name and a temper.
column2: 这儿每条船都有名字，也都有脾气。

column1: You can tell who's out by the colour of the sails.
column2: 看帆的颜色就知道谁出海了。

column1: {other} and I have worked {place} so long we don't need to talk.
column2: 我和{other}在{place}共事太久，已经不用说话了。

column1: {other} taught the new ones the ropes at {place}.
{other} and I finish each other's sentences at {place} now.
column2: 现在我和{other}在{place}一个开口，另一个就能接上。

column1: {other} had me up and down the lane all day.
column2: {other}让我在巷子里跑上跑下一整天。

column1: Fetched a parcel off the ferry for {other}.
column2: 替{other}从渡轮上取了个包裹。

column1: {other}'s list was longer than my arm.
Sold {other} a teapot with no lid.
{other} bought the last jar of jam off my stall.
column2: {other}买走了我摊上最后一罐果酱。

column1: {other} said my stall's the best thing about Saturdays.
column2: {other}说我的摊子是周六最好的东西。

column1: Swapped {other} a lamp for a hat.
column2: 拿一盏灯跟{other}换了一顶帽子。

column1: {other} minded the stall while I had my dinner.
column2: 我吃饭的时候，{other}帮我看着摊子。
风把我们的话都吹走了。

column1: {other} and I sat on the top and said nothing for an hour.
column2: 我和{other}坐在崖顶，一个钟头没说话。

column1: The path's worn smooth where {other} and I always stop.
column2: 我和{other}总停下的那段路，都被踩平了。

column1: {other} knows the name of every flower up there.
column2: 上面每种花的名字{other}都知道。

column1: Up the cliffs with {other} before breakfast.
{other} and I had our usual corner.
Talked boats with {other} till last orders.
{other} and I drank to absent friends.
column2: 我和{other}为不在的朋友干了一杯。

column1: {other} shuffles like a card sharp these days.
The pot went cold, we talked so long.
column2: 我们聊得太久，茶都凉了。

column1: {other} told me their news over tea.
column2: 喝茶时{other}跟我说了他们的新鲜事。

column1: {other} has a cup with their name on it at mine now.
column2: 现在我家有个写着{other}名字的杯子。

column1: Tea with {other}, same as every week.
{other} fixed my wobbly table while the kettle boiled.
column2: 水还没烧开，{other}就把我那张晃悠的桌子修好了。

column1: Danced with {other} till the fiddler gave up.
column2: 和{other}跳到拉琴的都拉不动了。

column1: {other} and I have a dance of our own now.
column2: 现在我和{other}有了自己的舞。

column1: Everyone stopped to watch {other} and me.
{other} swung me round so fast I saw stars.
{other} and I watched the tide turn, talking.
column2: 我和{other}边聊边看潮水转向。

column1: {other} told me about the old harbour.
{other} and I talked about the years gone by.
column2: 我和{other}聊起了过去的岁月。

column1: {other} says the water's warmer than it was.

column2: 我们把天下大事都理顺了。

column1: {other} needed a hand with a heavy crate at {place}.
{other} and I fixed the roof at {place} between us.
column2: 我和{other}两个人把{place}的屋顶修好了。

column1: They'll pay me back in pie.
{other} and I shifted half of {place} this afternoon.
column2: 今天下午我和{other}把{place}搬了一半。

column1: {other} can tie a bowline with their eyes shut now.
column2: 现在{other}闭着眼都能打单套结。

column1: Showed {other} a knot my grandad taught me.
column2: 教了{other}一个我爷爷教我的结。

column1: {other} tied a knot I'd never seen.
{other} is teaching the children knots now.
{other} and I made a rope ladder.
{other} and I have a plan for the spring.
{other} and I are planning a party for the whole harbour.
column2: 我和{other}在筹划一场全港口的聚会。

column1: # v1.0: corners, subjects, works, the harbour's own works, birthdays
the mooring ring with the brass plate
Somebody's great-grandfather fitted that. It's never once pulled out.
column2: 不知道是谁的曾祖父装的。从来没松过一次。

column1: the gap in the harbour wall
Kids squeeze through here to fish. So did I.
column2: 孩子们从这儿钻过去钓鱼。我小时候也是。

column1: the fish scales on the old weigh-house door
Every record catch is nailed up here. Mine's the small one.
column2: 每一次破纪录的渔获都钉在这儿。小的那片是我的。

column1: the smugglers' cave under the point
Nobody's smuggled anything for a hundred years. Probably.
column2: 一百年没人走私过东西了。大概吧。

column1: the capstan on the old slip
Push it round and it still sings.
column2: 推着转一圈，它还会唱歌呢。

column1: the names carved in the quay railing
column2: 刻在码头栏杆上的名字

column1: Every couple on the island has had a go at this rail.
column2: 岛上每一对恋人都在这栏杆上刻过字。

column1: the lamp that never lights by the ferry steps
column2: 渡轮台阶旁那盏从不亮的灯

column1: It hasn't worked since I was born. We leave it for luck.
column2: 我出生起它就没亮过。我们留着它图个吉利。

column1: the crab line spot on the east wall
Bacon on a string. Works every time.
column2: 绳子上绑块培根。每次都灵。

column1: the drying green behind the cottages
Monday is wash day. The whole island flaps.
column2: 星期一是洗衣日。全岛的衣服都在风里扑腾。

column1: the coil of rope nobody owns
It's been there forty years. Nobody dares move it.
column2: 在那儿放了四十年了。没人敢挪。

column1: the high-tide mark from the great flood
The water came up to here. Look how high.
column2: 水涨到了这儿。你看有多高。

column1: They used to check your pockets here. Now it keeps the gulls dry.
column2: 以前在这儿搜你的口袋。现在只给海鸥挡雨。

column1: the fishermen's chapel on the rocks
Just a room and a candle. Everyone stops in before a storm.
column2: 只有一间屋子和一支蜡烛。暴风雨前大家都会进来坐坐。

column1: She washed up one spring. We never found out whose.
column2: 有一年春天它被冲上岸。我们一直不知道是谁的。

column1: It's warm by four o'clock. Get there early.
column2: 下午四点它就晒暖了。得早点去占。

column1: the spot where the seals haul out
column2: 海豹上岸晒太阳的地方

column1: Stay low and quiet. There, see the pup?
column2: 蹲低点，别出声。看，那只小海豹。

column1: Before fridges, the whole catch went in here.
column2: 没有冰箱的年代，所有渔获都放在这里。

column1: the lookout post on the headland
Somebody watched for boats from here every night for a century.
column2: 一百年来，每天夜里都有人在这儿守望归船。

column1: the shell midden at the top of the beach
Oyster shells from before anyone remembers. Layers of them.
column2: 比谁的记忆都早的牡蛎壳。一层又一层。

column1: the bench where the ferry queue waits
You hear all the news on this bench. All of it.
column2: 在这张长椅上什么消息都能听到。什么都能。

column1: Green, white and one blue piece a year, if you're lucky.
column2: 绿的，白的，运气好一年能捡到一块蓝的。

column1: Somebody always wants to fix the winch. Nobody ever does.
column2: 总有人想把这台绞车修好。从来没人真动手。

column1: the fishing flags in the net store
Every family had a flag. Ours is the torn one.
column2: 每家都有一面旗。我们家的是破的那面。

column1: the rope walk along the back lane
They twisted rope here once, all the way down the lane.
column2: 以前人们在这儿搓绳子，一直搓到巷子尽头。

column1: the puffin ledge on the cliff
In May it's all beaks and wings. Bring a coat.
column2: 五月里全是嘴和翅膀。带件外套。

column1: the wreck you can see at low spring tide
column2: 大潮退去时才露出的沉船

column1: Twice a year her ribs come up. Then she's gone again.
column2: 一年两次，它的船骨会露出水面。然后又不见了。

column1: Stand here at six. The whole sea turns pink.
column2: 早上六点站在这儿。整片海都会变成粉色。

column1: the old boat shed with the painted doors
column2: 门漆成各种颜色的旧船棚

column1: Every door a different colour. Nobody agreed.
column2: 每扇门颜色都不一样。谁也说服不了谁。

column1: the stone steps worn smooth by boots
Two hundred years of boots made that dip.
column2: 两百年的靴子踩出了这个凹坑。

column1: the pool where the children learn to swim
Cold enough to make you yell. Everyone learns here.
column2: 冷得能让你叫出声。大家都是在这儿学会的。

column1: the whalebone arch on the cliff path
column2: 悬崖小路上的鲸骨拱门

column1: From a whale that beached when my gran was small.
column2: 那头鲸搁浅的时候，我奶奶还是个小姑娘。

column1: the gutting table on the quay
Not pretty, but it's where the day's money is made.
column2: 不好看，可一天的钱就是在这儿挣的。

column1: the old signal flags in the harbour office
Each one means something. I know three.
column2: 每面旗都有含义。我认得三面。

column1: the spring that runs fresh on the beach
Fresh water, right beside the salt. Taste it.
column2: 咸水旁边就是淡水。你尝尝。

column1: the heron's post at the stream mouth
Same heron every morning. We call him the Mayor.
column2: 每天早上都是同一只苍鹭。我们叫它镇长。

column1: Where the lobsters wait for the ferry. Poor things.
column2: 龙虾们在这儿等渡轮。可怜的家伙。

column1: the storm shutters on the harbour cottages
Up in October, down in April. Like clockwork.
column2: 十月装上，四月卸下。准得像钟表。

column1: the lantern hooks along the pier
On feast nights every hook has a lantern.
column2: 节庆的夜里，每个钩子都挂着一盏灯。

column1: the painted stone at the end of the jetty
Whoever finds it moves it. It's been round the island twice.
column2: 谁找到谁就挪个地方。它已经绕岛两圈了。

column1: the fog bell on the point
When the fog's in, it rings all night. You stop hearing it.
column2: 起雾的时候它响一整夜。听久了就听不见了。

column1: They made salt here once. Now the rain fills them.
column2: 以前这里晒盐。现在只装雨水。

column1: Smells of tar. I love it.
the view from the top of the harbour steps
Count the boats from here. Every one's home.
column2: 在这儿数数船。每一艘都回家了。

column1: the bottle of messages under the quay
People leave notes in it for whoever comes next.
column2: 大家往里面留纸条，给下一个来的人。

column1: the kelp beds off the rocks
At slack water you can see right down. Like a forest.
column2: 平潮的时候能一眼看到底。像一片森林。

column1: Older than me. It gets fed before I do.
column2: 比我年纪还大。我还没吃饭，先喂它。

column1: My mother's hand, my gran's hand, and mine at the bottom.
column2: 我母亲的字，我外婆的字，最下面是我的。

column1: the window where the loaves cool
The whole lane knows when the bread's out.
column2: 面包一出炉，整条巷子都知道。

column1: the flour sacks by the door
Mainland flour, island water. That's the secret.
column2: 大陆的面粉，岛上的水。这就是秘诀。

column1: Driftwood burns hot. Salt makes it spit blue.
column2: 漂流木烧得旺。里面的盐会溅出蓝火花。

column1: Warm as a hug. Don't open the door.
column2: 暖得像被人抱着。别开门。

column1: the crack in the bakery counter
Where my dad dropped the cash box in 1970-something.
column2: 我爸有一年把钱箱摔在这儿。七十年代的事了。

column1: Hens, a bench and a lot of crumbs.
column2: 几只母鸡，一张长椅，满地面包屑。

column1: Every paddle has a job. This one's for Sundays.
column2: 每把铲子都有用处。这把是星期天用的。
面包房收到的第一枚硬币，裱在框里

column1: The first penny ever taken here. Never spent.
column2: 这里收到的第一个便士。从没花掉。

column1: the herb pots on the bakery sill
column2: 面包房窗台上的香草盆

column1: Rosemary for the focaccia. Don't pinch it.
column2: 迷迭香是做佛卡夏用的。别掐。

column1: the cake stands in the cupboard
Wedding cakes, birthday cakes. They've held them all.
column2: 婚礼蛋糕，生日蛋糕。它们全都托过。

column1: the bakery clock that runs fast
column2: 快了十分钟的面包房挂钟

column1: Ten minutes fast, so I'm never late. It never works.
column2: 特意调快十分钟，好让我不迟到。从来没用。

column1: It goes round the lanes on Saturdays. Half comes back eaten.
column2: 每星期六提着它走街串巷。回来的时候少了一半。

column1: the bread stamp with the anchor on it
Every loaf gets the anchor. It's how you know it's ours.
column2: 每个面包都盖上这个锚。一看就知道是我们家的。

column1: the attic window over the bakery
You can see the ferry an hour before it comes.
column2: 渡轮来之前一个钟头就能从这儿看见。

column1: They're a gram out. The customers win.
column2: 差一克。占便宜的是客人。

column1: The warmest seat on the island. It's mine.
column2: 全岛最暖和的座位。是我的。

column1: the jam shelf in the bakery pantry
column2: 面包房储藏室的果酱架

column1: Every jar's labelled with the year. That's 2003's.
column2: 每罐都标着年份。那罐是零三年的。

column1: Big enough to bath a baby in. Don't ask.
column2: 大得能给婴儿洗澡。别问。

column1: the rolling pin carved from a mast
From a ship's mast. Heavier than it looks.
column2: 用船桅做的。比看起来重。

column1: Today's bread, and a joke if I've got one.
column2: 写着今天的面包，想得出来的话再加个笑话。

column1: The first loaf of the day gets eaten right here.
column2: 每天第一个面包就是在这儿吃掉的。

column1: She doesn't earn her keep. She knows it.
column2: 她可不是来干活的。她自己也知道。

column1: the hatch where the flour comes in
Stand back when the sacks drop.
column2: 麻袋落下来的时候站远点。

column1: the ship's bell over the bar
Last orders. Ring it and you buy a round.
column2: 最后一轮点单。敲了它，你就得请全场一轮。

column1: Three keys don't work. We play around them.
column2: 有三个键不响。我们绕着弹。

column1: Burns all winter. We've never let it go out.
column2: 整个冬天都烧着。我们从没让它熄过。

column1: Everyone who leaves sends one back. Everyone.
column2: 每个离开的人都会寄一张回来。每一个。

column1: Painted by a sailor who paid his bill with it.
column2: 一个水手画的，他拿这个抵了酒钱。

column1: the corner table by the window
Where the fishermen sit. Nobody else, ever.
column2: 渔夫们坐的地方。别人从来不坐。

column1: the pub's chalk scores from the quiz
column2: 酒馆问答赛的粉笔比分

column1: The same team's won for eleven years. Mine.
column2: 同一支队赢了十一年。是我的队。

column1: the tankards on hooks above the bar
column2: 吧台上方挂着的啤酒杯

column1: Everyone has their own. Don't touch Noah's.
column2: 每人都有自己的一只。别碰诺亚的。

column1: Sixty years of names. Some of them famous. None of them sober.
column2: 六十年的名字。有几个挺有名。没一个是清醒时写的。

column1: the stuffed fish over the door
Caught by my grandfather. It gets bigger every time he tells it.
column2: 我爷爷钓的。他每讲一次，鱼就大一圈。

column1: They creak on the third step. Useful for knowing who's coming.
column2: 第三级会吱嘎响。能听出谁上来了。

column1: Every barrel has a nickname. That one's Dolores.
column2: 每个桶都有外号。那个叫多洛蕾丝。

column1: Three umbrellas, a false tooth and a trumpet.
column2: 三把伞，一颗假牙，还有一把小号。

column1: Two people fit. Three if they like each other.
column2: 能坐两个人。关系好的话能挤三个。

column1: Every cap from every summer. We're running out of wall.
column2: 每个夏天的每个瓶盖。墙快不够用了。

column1: the old skittles in the pub cupboard
We used to play every Friday. Maybe again.
column2: 以前每个星期五都玩。说不定还会再玩。

column1: the window seat where the storytellers sit
If you sit there, you owe the room a story.
column2: 坐在那儿，就欠大家一个故事。

column1: the tide clock at the Anchor
More use than a real clock, round here.
Chips come through here. Nothing else matters.
column2: 薯条从这儿递出来。别的都不重要。

column1: the fiddle hanging on the pub wall
column2: 挂在酒馆墙上的小提琴

column1: Whoever can play it, may. Few can.
column2: 谁会拉就可以拉。会的人不多。

column1: the ship in a bottle behind the bar
Nobody knows how it got in. Nobody's getting it out.
column2: 没人知道它怎么进去的。也没人打算把它弄出来。

column1: Tap it twice. If it drops, stay in.
column2: 敲两下。指针往下掉的话，就别出门了。

column1: For the children. The grown-ups use it more.
column2: 本来是给孩子们的。大人们坐得更多。

column1: the list of lifeboat crews on the pub wall
column2: 酒馆墙上的救生艇船员名单

column1: Every name who ever went out. Some didn't come back.
column2: 每一个出过海的人的名字。有些再也没回来。

column1: Everyone's best score. Mine's not up there. Yet.
column2: 每个人的最好成绩。我的还没上榜。暂时。

column1: It only gets the shipping forecast. That's all we need.
column2: 只收得到海上天气预报。我们也只要这个。

column1: the jar of foreign coins by the till
column2: 收银台边装外国硬币的罐子

column1: From visitors all over. That one's from Peru.
column2: 全世界来的客人留下的。那枚是秘鲁的。

column1: Up the ladder. Best fireworks view there is.
column2: 爬梯子上来。看烟花最好的地方。

column1: the pub's cosy nook behind the stairs
Where people go to say things quietly.
column2: 大家要说悄悄话就来这儿。

column1: the painted panel of the first regatta
column2: 画着第一届赛船会的木板

column1: Look closely. That's Noah's grandad, losing.
column2: 仔细看。那是诺亚的爷爷，输了。

column1: the height marks on the school door
Every child measured, every September. Some of these are grandparents now.
column2: 每个孩子，每年九月都量一次。有些现在都当爷爷奶奶了。

column1: A crab shell, a gull feather and a very old conker.
column2: 一只蟹壳，一根海鸥羽毛，还有一颗很老的七叶树果。

column1: The children read it every morning. They're very strict.
column2: 孩子们每天早上都要读数。他们可认真了。

column1: the old school desks in the store
Initials in every lid. Look, there's Noah's.
column2: 每个桌盖上都刻着名字缩写。看，那是诺亚的。

column1: Three crowns, a pirate hat and a cow.
column2: 三顶王冠，一顶海盗帽，还有一头奶牛。

column1: the globe with the island drawn on
column2: 画着我们小岛的地球仪

column1: The children drew us on. We're bigger than Ireland.
column2: 孩子们把我们画上去了。我们比爱尔兰还大。

column1: One goldfish, called Captain. He's older than the teacher.
column2: 一条金鱼，叫船长。它比老师还老。

column1: the school's piano stool full of music
Every song the island ever sang, in one stool.
column2: 岛上唱过的每一首歌，都在这张凳子里。

column1: the chalk drawings on the playground wall
The rain washes them off. They draw them again.
column2: 雨一来就冲掉。他们就再画。

column1: One of each pair. Always one of each.
column2: 每双只剩一只。永远只剩一只。

column1: Open it in fifty years. I'll be ninety.
column2: 五十年后打开。那时候我就九十岁了。

column1: Every cushion sewn by a different mother.
column2: 每个靠垫都是不同的妈妈缝的。

column1: Stuck on the ceiling. They glow at night, if you stay late.
column2: 贴在天花板上。待得晚的话，晚上会发光。

column1: the pegs where the lunchboxes hang
You can tell whose is whose by the smell.
column2: 闻味道就知道哪个是谁的。

column1: the old slates in the school cupboard
Before paper was cheap. Still squeak like anything.
column2: 纸还贵的年代用的。现在写起来还是吱吱响。

column1: A shell from every beach. The children argue about which is best.
column2: 每片海滩都有一枚。孩子们天天争哪个最好看。

column1: the crooked tree in the playground
Every child climbs it. Every child falls out once.
column2: 每个孩子都爬过。每个孩子都摔下来过一次。

column1: Twelve names, in ink. One of them is my great-gran.

column2: 什么颜色都有，就是没蓝色。蓝色总是先用完。

column1: The children learn the tides before their times tables.
column2: 孩子们先学潮汐，再学乘法表。

column1: Never been blown. It's the threat that works.
column2: 从来没吹过。光吓唬就够了。

column2: 渡轮一经过，所有人都挥手。每一次都是。

column1: Just a big puddle, really. Nobody tell them.

column2: 所有的学校合照都是在这张长凳上拍的。

column1: In summer we have lessons under it. Nobody listens.
column2: 夏天我们在树下上课。谁也不听。

column1: The old bell, before the tower. Heavy as a brick.
column2: 有钟楼之前用的老铃。沉得像块砖。

column2: 一千只纸鹤，许一个愿。我们折到九百了。

column2: 游一个来回就贴一颗金星。你看有多少。

column2: 角落里画着海怪。孩子们说到现在还是准的。

column2: 我是闻着面包房的香味找到家的。

column2: 总在五月一号。总是个错误。

column1: You don't swim, exactly. You scream and get out.
column2: 说是游泳，其实就是尖叫一声再爬上来。

column2: 我奶奶管它们叫海上的小丑。

column1: My dad wouldn't let anyone speak while it was on.
column2: 它一开始播，我爸就不许任何人说话。

column2: 每口井的水味道都不一样。蒙着眼我都能分出来。

column1: Some say the old well by the chapel is lucky.
column2: 有人说小教堂边那口老井能带来好运。

column1: September, purple fingers, scratched arms. Best month.
column2: 九月，紫色的手指，划破的胳膊。最好的月份。

column1: Everyone has a secret bush. Mine's the best.
column2: 每个人都有一丛秘密的黑莓。我的那丛最好。

column2: 信号弹一升空，岛上所有男人都往外跑。

column2: 我从没坐过它。希望永远不用。

column2: 裹点燕麦煎一煎。没有比这更好吃的。

column1: In August the hill goes purple overnight.

column2: 我爷爷会四十首。我只会四首。

column2: 每个孩子都怂恿别人游过去看看。

column1: Cards, soup and stories. That's winter.
column2: 打牌，喝汤，讲故事。这就是冬天。

column2: 每个月两次，海水一直涨到门口。

column2: 没人信有鬼。可也没人夜里走悬崖小路。

column2: 小教堂的灰衣女人？我姑姑见过。两次。

column2: 他跑这条航线四十年了。一次都没晕过船。

column2: 看包裹就知道每家每户的事。

column2: 以前大家把网棚腾空，一直跳到天亮。

column2: 有些东西从前更好。大多数不是。

column2: 十二种奶酪。谁需要十二种？

Force nine and the whole harbour groans.

column1: The sea came right into the chapel.

column1: Some folk can't stand it. I can't live without it.

column1: He played at every wedding for sixty years.
column2: 六十年来每场婚礼都是他拉琴。

column2: 他去世的时候，全岛安静了一个星期。

column2: 它在每家都有一个不同的名字。
